messages:
Priya R: Quick Friday note — weekly capacity readout for Saturn cluster (eu-west-1) shows a sustained +22% GPU-hour consumption vs forecast and 2x queue depth on low-priority slots.
Jared H: Oof, any specific tenants spiking?
Priya R: Mostly embed-heavy workloads from growth team and a new internal eval job. Spike started Wed, same node pool (saturn-pool-2).
Marta S: I've got the heap traces — network egress to our vector store increased. Could be cache misses causing regen.
Luis Z: Could we temporarily increase burst_capacity for saturn-pool-2 to 40% and throttle non-prod reruns? Want to avoid preemptions.
Priya R: Proposal: autoscale delta +20 GPUs tonight at 02:00 UTC, shift low-priority jobs to saturn-pool-3 (apac spare) and enable cross-region routing. Thoughts?
Jared H: Sounds OK. Any cost estimate for the event?
Luis Z: Rough ballpark: +420 GPU-hours = ~$6.3k at reserved vs spot mix. I'll tag finance and put a PO note.
Marta S: I'll push the routing change. Patch:
```
# route override
route: saturn-pool-2 -> saturn-pool-3
max_burst: 20
priority_shift: non-prod -> true
```
OpsBot: deploy-triggered: routing/patch applied by Marta S at 22:10 UTC — canary to 5 pods
Priya R: Monitor metrics: queue depth, 95th latency for generation, and spot preemption rate. We'll re-evaluate 03:30 UTC.
Jared H: I'll keep a live dashboard open. @Luis Z please confirm finance ok, otherwise we'll scale back.
Luis Z: noted, pinging finance-channel now :email:
Priya R: Thanks team — short follow-up thread in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
